newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Gist posts broad sales growth in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Gist posts broad sales growth in 1996.

text.p: Dutch biochemicals and food group Gist-Brocades NV said on Wednesday all three of its divisions contributed to turnover growth in 1996.
The company did not provide separate earnings figures for the three divisions but gave the following turnover figures:
Gist-Brocades described business developments in 1996 at the three divisions as follows:

Pressure on prices in international markets in second half of 1996 as a result of increased supplies of antibiotics from China and India had little impact on 1996 results. Efficiency measures offset the effect of higher raw material prices in the first half of 1996. After initial dealys production of clavulanic acid has now started in Sweden. Stakes in Orfaquim (Mexico) and Acopharma (Egypt) were raised to 100 pct.

Improvement was attributable to further recovery in price of fresh yeast in Europe and contribution of activities in Latin America. 1996 was a good year for sales of bread improvers. The division made acquisitions in Brazil and Peru.

Dairy ingredients and beverage ingredients both had a good year. Five acquisitions were made in dairy ingredients (two in Italy and one each in Australia, France and U.S.). Cost- effective produiction enabled savoury ingredients to turn in a satisfactory performance despite pressure on prices.
